title: leucanthemum vulgare subsp. alpicola
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. alpicola, commonly known as alpine daisy, is a plant species within the daisy family that is native to high-altitude mountainous regions. The alpine daisy is rich in health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of alpine daisy are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that can modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential.
